title: Universal information measure
confusion_guard: A closed dictionary that numbers every measurable is a measure — that is the right word. It is not automatically a law of nature. Entropy in its gravitational form is the area law, in-domain only for horizons. 11D branes are SYM as ontology. Sub-Planck R_s STOPS the geometric station. Same kilogram as m = h f / c²; extra claim is the closure and the universality.
definitions: A measure assigns a number to every admissible measurable.
Here the mass number is m = h f / c², or equivalently S/k constructed from m via a Schwarzschild area, under declared constants h, c, G.
Closing the loop through an 11D brane is a dictionary between inertial mass-equivalent, horizon entropy, and worldvolume degrees of freedom.
T€@X (2026) information mass is the inertial station of the loop.
mechanism: Planck and Einstein supply E and inertia. T€@X names the kilogram information mass. Bekenstein–Hawking supplies the area law. 11D M-theory supplies a candidate microstate substrate. Composing them yields a number for every f. Composition is not automatic promotion: G and ℓ_P are extra constants, and lab frequencies give R_s << ℓ_P.
predictions: Given f, the software returns a unique (E, m, R_s, S/k) from declared constants.
For all laboratory frequencies, R_s(m) << ℓ_P, so the geometric-entropy station is out of domain.
No surplus mass beyond E/c² appears when information content is varied at fixed energy.
assumptions: The measurable is a frequency-encoded carrier (information-mass assumption).
Geometric entropy is evaluated on the Schwarzschild horizon of that mass.
That evaluation is only in-domain when R_s >> ℓ_P.
The brane station is a duality dictionary, not a laboratory object.
falsification_conditions: A unique, parameter-free continuation of the loop below ℓ_P that disagrees with a preregistered Planck-scale observable.
A brane dictionary that predicts a laboratory mass excess not equal to E/c².
Promotion of the loop to EST without an in-domain horizon (R_s >> ℓ_P) or an independent brane observable.
primary_sources: T€@X™ (2026), proposed information-mass interpretation of m = h f / c²

evidence.source: UPI software: m, R_s, S/k from f with SI constants
evidence.notes: Software arithmetic for the numbers. Does not establish the physical loop.

evidence.source: T€@X™ (2026), information mass as the inertial station of a closed measure
evidence.notes: Authorship of the identification. Not a measurement of 11D branes or of sub-Planck horizons.

equations: loop: f -> m -> S -> brane -> f
description: A proposed closed measure: every physical encoding with frequency f is assigned the existing mass equivalent m = h f / c², with a proposed geometric entropy S = k A(m)/(4 ℓ_P²), a dual 11D brane dictionary, and a return to the encoding. The loop is HYP. The 11D closure is SYM. The geometric-entropy step STOPS when the Schwarzschild radius of m falls below ℓ_P.
